View conversations, execution status and requests for input, or continue tasks on Google’s official Remote Control website.
Google sign-in is handled by your system browser. Task lists and status update on the website. agenT does not sync this data or send Antigravity task notifications.
1. In the desktop Antigravity App, open Settings → App → Enable Remote Control.
2. For CLI sessions, run /remote-control in the session, or launch agy --remote-control.

3. Sign in with the same Google Account on your phone and select the computer. Keep it powered on and online; exiting an interactive CLI session ends its connection. This entry supports the App / CLI; consult Google’s documentation for legacy IDE support.

Queries Google directly from your phone without an always-on computer. Import an existing OAuth grant, not a Google password or Gemini API key.

Accepts official CLI OAuth JSON and CodexBar credential exports. Requires access_token (or a plain access token); optional refresh_token, client_id, client_secret, expiry_date (milliseconds) and project_id. Automatic renewal needs refresh_token and client_id from the same grant, plus client_secret if required by that client. No OAuth client credentials are bundled. Import only your own grant locally; never send it to chat or logs.
